mapper.sql: SELECT b.*, c.id AS cat_id, c.name AS cat_name, c.color AS cat_color, c.icon AS cat_icon, c.parent_id AS cat_parent_id, pc.name AS cat_parent_name, u.nickname AS uploader_nickname FROM block b LEFT JOIN sound_category c ON c.id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN sound_category pc ON pc.id = c.parent_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = b.uploader_id

sql.where:
b.is_active = true AND b.status = #{status}
AND (b.category_id = #{categoryId} OR b.category_id IN (SELECT id FROM sound_category WHERE parent_id = #{categoryId}))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM block_tag bt WHERE bt.block_id = b.id AND bt.tag_id IN #{tagId})
AND b.title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO block (title, description, file_key, master_file_key, thumbnail_key, duration, price, category_id, uploader_id, license, source_url, attribution, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{fileKey}, #{masterFileKey}, #{thumbnailKey}, #{duration}, #{price}, #{categoryId}, #{uploaderId}, #{license}, #{sourceUrl}, #{attribution}, #{status})
mapper.select: WHERE b.is_active = true AND b.id IN #{id}

SELECT recent.recent_plays, x.* FROM (
WHERE b.is_active = true AND b.status = 'APPROVED' ) x JOIN ( SELECT target_id, COUNT(*) AS recent_plays FROM play_log WHERE target_type = 'BLOCK' AND played_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => #{days}) GROUP BY target_id ) recent ON recent.target_id = x.id ORDER BY recent.recent_plays DESC, x.play_count DESC, x.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE block SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE block SET play_count = play_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
